title: CPF Module Schema: Load Balancer Module
description: JSON schema for CPF module 'cpf-azure-prdsvc-loadbalancer'. Use this to generate Terraform code that calls the CPF module.

app_id.description: (Required) A descriptive name (abbreviation) for the workload (application) as it is registered in Leanix. The identifier format in Leanix is 'APP-12345', for the purpose of naming resources only 5 number will be used.

backend_pool_names.description: (Optional) List of backend pool names for the Load Balancer.

context.description: (Optional) Application context information for the resource(s) (max 10 chars).

environment.description: (Required) The environment where the resource is deployed. Given as abbreviation to leave more characters to the other naming components (max 3 chars).

instance.description: (Optional) Instance number, if context includes/requires multiple resources of the same type (max 3 int).

lb_frontend_ip_configurations.type: list(object({ subnet_id = string name = string zones = optional(list(number)) private_ip_address = optional(string) private_ip_address_allocation = optional(string, "Dynamic") private_ip_address_version = optional(string, "IPv4") gateway_load_balancer_frontend_ip_configuration_id = optional(string) }))
lb_frontend_ip_configurations.description: "(Optional) List containing load balancer frontend ip configuration parameters" object({ name = "(Required) Specifies the name of the frontend IP configuration." subnet_id = "(Required)The ID of the Subnet which should be associated with the IP Configuration." zones = "(Optional) Specifies a list of Availability Zones in which the IP Address for this Load Balancer should be located." private_ip_address = "(Optional) Private IP Address to assign to the Load Balancer. The last one and first four IPs in any range are reserved and cannot be manually assigned." private_ip_address_allocation = "(Optional) The allocation method for the Private IP Address used by this Load Balancer. Possible values as Dynamic and Static." gateway_load_balancer_frontend_ip_configuration_id = "(Optional) The Frontend IP Configuration ID of a Gateway SKU Load Balancer." })

lb_nat_pools.type: map(object({ protocol = string frontend_ip_configuration_name = string frontend_port_start = number frontend_port_end = number backend_port = number }))
lb_nat_pools.description: "(Optional) Map containing load balancer nat pool parameters" object({ protocol = "(Required) The transport protocol for the external endpoint. Possible values are Udp or Tcp." frontend_ip_configuration_name = "(Required) frontend ip name of the load balancer" frontend_port_start = "(Required) The first port number in the range of external ports that will be used to provide Inbound NAT to NICs associated with this Load Balancer. Possible values range between 1 and 65534." frontend_port_end = "(Required) The last port number in the range of external ports that will be used to provide Inbound NAT to NICs associated with this Load Balancer. Possible values range between 1 and 65534" backend_port = "(Required) The port used for internal connections on the endpoint.Values between 0 and 65535." })

lb_nat_rules.type: map(object({ protocol = string frontend_ip_configuration_name = string frontend_port = number backend_port = number idle_timeout_in_minutes = optional(number) enable_floating_ip = optional(bool, false) enable_tcp_reset = optional(bool, false) }))
lb_nat_rules.description: (Optional) Map containing load balancer nat rules object({ protocol = "(Required) The transport protocol for the external endpoint. Possible values are `\"Tcp, Udp or All\" frontend_ip_configuration_name = "(Required) frontend ip name of the load balancer" backend_pool_name = "(Required) backendpool name of the load balancer" frontend_port = "(Required) port used for External connections on the endpoint. Values between 0 and 65534." backend_port = "(Required) The port used for internal connections on the endpoint.Values between 0 and 65535." idle_timeout_in_minutes = "(Optional) Specifies the idle timeout in minutes for TCP connections. Values are between 4 and 30 minutes" enable_floating_ip = "(Optional) Are the Floating IPs enabled for this Load Balncer Rule? A `\"floating\"` IP is reassigned to a secondary server in case the primary server fails. Required to configure a SQL AlwaysOn Availability Group. Defaults to false" enable_tcp_reset = "(Optional) Is TCP Reset enabled for this Load Balancer Rule? Defaults to false." }) `

lb_probes.type: map(object({ protocol = string port = number request_path = optional(string) interval_in_seconds = optional(number) number_of_probes = optional(number) probe_threshold = optional(number) }))
lb_probes.description: "(Required) Map containing load balancer probes parameters" object({ protocol = "(Required) The transport protocol for the external endpoint. Possible values are Udp or Tcp." port = "(Required) Port on which the Probe queries the backend endpoint. Values between 0 and 65535, inclusive." request_path = "(Optional) The URI used for requesting health status from the backend endpoint. Required if probe_protocol is set to Http" interval_in_seconds = "(Optional) The interval, in seconds between probes to the backend endpoint for health status." number_of_probes = "(Optional, deprecated) The number of failed probe attempts after which the backend endpoint is removed from rotation." probe_threshold = "(Optional) The number of consecutive successful or failed probes that allow or deny traffic to this endpoint." })

lb_rules.type: map(object({ frontend_ip_configuration_name = string backend_pool_name = string protocol = string frontend_port = string backend_port = number probe_name = optional(string) enable_floating_ip = optional(bool, false) disable_outbound_snat = optional(bool, false) enable_tcp_reset = optional(bool, false) load_distribution = optional(string) idle_timeout_in_minutes = optional(number) }))
lb_rules.description: (Optional) Map containing load balancer rule and probe object({ frontend_ip_configuration_name = "(Required) frontend ip name of the load balancer" backend_pool_name = "(Required) backendpool name of the load balancer" protocol = "(Required) The transport protocol for the external endpoint. Possible values are `\"Tcp, Udp or All\" frontend_port = "(Required) The port for the external endpoint. Port numbers for each Rule must be unique within the Load Balancer. Set this frontend port to 0 if lb_protocol is set to `\"All\"`. Values between `\"0 and 65535\" backend_port = "(Required) The port used for internal connections on the endpoint. Set this backend port to 0 if lb_protocol is set to \"All\". probe_name = "(Optional) The name of a Probe used by this Load Balancing Rule." enable_floating_ip = "(Optional) Are the Floating IPs enabled for this Load Balncer Rule? A `\"floating\"` IP is reassigned to a secondary server in case the primary server fails. Required to configure a SQL AlwaysOn Availability Group. Defaults to false" disable_outbound_snat = "(Optional) Is snat enabled for this Load Balancer Rule? Default false." enable_tcp_reset = "(Optional) Is TCP Reset enabled for this Load Balancer Rule? Defaults to false." load_distribution = "(Optional) Specifies the load balancing distribution type to be used by the Load Balancer. Possible values are `\"Default,SourceIP,SourceIPProtocol\"`." idle_timeout_in_minutes = "(Optional) Specifies the idle timeout in minutes for TCP connections. Values are between 4 and 30 minutes" })

resource_group_name.description: (Required) Name of the Resource Group in which to create the resource.

sku.description: (Optional) The SKU of the Azure Load Balancer. Accepted values are Basic and Standard. Defaults to Basic.

sku_tier.description: (Optional) The Sku Tier of this Load Balancer. Possible values are Global and Regional.

tags.description: (Optional) Tags to be set on each resource.

backend_ids.description: The list of backend pool address IDs.

backend_map_ids.description: The map of backend pool address IDs.

frontend_ip_configurations.description: The list of frontend configurations names.

id.description: The Resource ID of the Load Balancer.

name.description: The Name of the Load Balancer.

private_ip_addresses.description: The list of private IP addresses assigned to the frontend configuration names.

probe_map_ids.description: The map of Load Balancer Probes.

rule_ids.description: The list of Load Balancer rules IDs.

agent_instructions.summary: To provision 'Loadbalancer' via Terraform, call this CPF module with the inputs defined below. Required inputs have no default and must be provided.
agent_instructions.module_type_notes: This is a single-service CPF module. It provisions one Azure resource type.
agent_instructions.naming_convention: Resource names are auto-generated by the module using app_id, environment, and region.
